scope: Independent controlled DOM VM only; no Chrome/native-layout/PG claim

results.case: Keyboard intent while a request is pending prevents old focus restoration
Moving to another control and back to body cannot be mistaken for native blur
A detached refresh element cannot receive restored focus
Programmatic click without originating focus cannot move focus into refresh
Storage invalidation disables the old control and removes all pending focus listeners
Two completed refresh cycles restore originating focus and leave no document listener
